name: eBay Buy API
tagline: Search and purchase products across eBay marketplaces via REST APIs
description: eBay Buy APIs let developers search listings, browse item details, and manage guest checkout and order flows on eBay marketplaces. The suite includes Browse, Order, Feed, Marketing, and related Buy resources under the eBay Developers Program, with OAuth application tokens for most read-only shopping use cases.
base_url: https://api.ebay.com/buy (most Buy APIs, e.g. Browse); guest Order API: https://apix.ebay.com/buy/order/v2

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (application token) for Browse and most Buy APIs; authorization code for user-consent Order flows. Create an app in the eBay Developers Program and request a token from the Identity API.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Sandbox and default call limits free via Developers Program. Browse API default 5,000 calls/day (most methods). Many Buy APIs are Limited Release: production needs eBay Partner Network approval plus free Application Growth Check (not guaranteed).
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial use and higher volumes governed by eBay API license and call limits; contact eBay for enterprise agreements

rate_limits: Published per API/resource in the eBay Developers Program call limits; typically application-level daily limits (exact numbers vary by API and tier)

example.request: curl -X GET 'https://api.ebay.com/buy/browse/v1/item_summary/search?q=iphone&limit=3' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN' -H 'X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID: EBAY_US' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'

use_cases: search eBay product listings by keyword
get item details and prices for a listing
retrieve seller and shipping info for an item
power affiliate or comparison shopping for eBay inventory
